annotations.title: Get the filings of an issuer in a date range

description: get_filings is the disclosures of an issuer in a date range: an issuer by ticker, ISIN or LEI plus a date range returns every filing and release on the record for that issuer in that range, each with its type, its date, its source page and its read date — signed by the node of the issuer's market and receipted. Served from the record as read; nothing new is collected and nothing is inferred. Typed errors: unknown_issuer, ambiguous, not_on_record (per field, per market), invalid_request. Door: https://mcp.getfilings.ai/mcp (routes to the owning node); every node door answers it for its own market.

issuer.description: Ticker (with exchange where it helps: NASDAQ:AAPL, SHEL.L), ISIN or LEI.
